item.title: Self-Hosted Diabetes CGM Monitoring Platforms: Nightscout vs xDrip+ vs Tidepool
item.description: Managing Type 1 diabetes requires continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) data that is accessible, private, and always available. While commercial platforms like Dexcom Clarity and Abbott LibreView offer cloud-based solutions, many in the diabetes community have built open-source, self-hosted alternatives that put you in control of your own health data. These platforms not only provide real-time glucose tracking but also enable remote monitoring by caregivers, predictive alerts, and integration with insulin pumps — all without sending your medical data to third-party servers.
